replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived promoter state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in Drosophila promoters (n = 5912 promoters).
Promoters were first binned based on their log2 Pol II ChIP-seq signal. Within each bin, the median frequency of each of the promoter state was calculated.
outputs.explanation: The panel aggregates data across a clearly stated number of promoters (n = 5912), and the replicate unit (promoters) is explicitly identified.
The panel reports the number of single DNA molecules analyzed for this representative locus (2952 molecules), and molecules are the stated unit underlying the quantified state percentages.

replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in mouse promoters (n = 6122 promoters).
outputs.explanation: The number of promoters (n = 6122) and the replicate type (promoters) are both clearly reported.
The number of molecules analyzed for this representative mouse locus (2871 molecules) is reported directly on the panel, along with the replicate unit.

Drosophila (TATA-less n = 422 promoters; TATA-containing n = 71 promoters)
The statistical comparisons between groups were performed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
outputs.explanation: Sample sizes are given for all four groups (minimum n = 64 promoters) and the replicate type (promoters) is explicitly stated, consistent with the boxplots and statistical comparison shown.
